content.short: Exaverse is a mobile-first, 8-bit style roguelike dungeon crawler featuring sentient dinosaurs.
content.description: Extinction of the Exaverse is a unique Web3 gaming experience that combines traditional roguelike mechanics with a sci-fi setting. Players control sentient dinosaurs known as Exadons in a fight against invading machine forces. Built for mobile platforms and utilizing Immutable-X for digital ownership, the game features turn-based strategic gameplay, deep character progression via Boons, and high replayability through procedural generation.
content.meta: Exaverse is a mobile-first, 8-bit style roguelike dungeon crawler. Discover Exaverse and other Decentralized Games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
